SO GOOD!!! it’s lightweight on the skin and doesn’t dry out feeling crackily. leaves the skin GLOWING but from the inside. The effect on the skin is lasting too - say you use it in the evening then apply your foundation again the morning after, it makes the foundation look less cakey as it will bring out more of your inner glow. my only downside is the price but if you can afford it it’s honestly a must.
